outcome: Cesarean delivery due to fetal distress
cohort: The study included women with uncomplicated term pregnancies, categorized by amniotic fluid index as having borderline oligohydramnios, oligohydramnios, or normal AFI.
finding: Borderline oligohydramnios in uncomplicated term pregnancies was associated with increased risks of delivering small-for-gestational-age neonates and requiring cesarean delivery due to fetal distress.
mod_finding: Borderline oligohydramnios was associated with an increased rate of cesarean delivery due to fetal distress.
birth_weight: Birthweight was measured as an outcome, and the occurrence of small-for-gestational-age neonates was also an outcome.
gest_age: The study included uncomplicated term pregnancies.
